Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: small optional orientation illustration for a youth running training app, displayed beside an analysis heading at 64 to 80 px.
Primary request: one original friendly tactile 3D object composition: a small folded ivory map card carrying a single simple teal running-track oval, with a chunky teal magnifying glass resting across one corner. The oval is only a pictorial track, not data or a chart.
Scene/backdrop: genuine transparent alpha background, no scene, no floor or background shadow.
Style/medium: softly rounded matte clay and thick paper miniature, calm contemporary Korean mobile-product illustration, independent original design.
Composition/framing: square canvas, centered composition filling about 76 percent of the image; slight three-quarter view; all pieces entirely visible; clear silhouette readable at 64 px; the track and magnifier should remain easily recognizable.
Lighting/mood: soft diffuse light, gentle form shading only on the objects, approachable without a face.
Color palette: restrained deep teal #0D5F5A, warm ivory #FAFAF7, charcoal #2B3330, tiny muted mint accents. No bright new colors.
Materials/textures: smooth matte clay with restrained paper grain; no glossy glass glare; simple solid magnifier lens with subtle clear center.
Constraints: no text, letters, numbers, labels, logos, watermark, badges, stars, medals, checkmarks, graphs, medical symbols or faces. No detached floating decorations. No border, plate, cast floor shadow or opaque backdrop. Do not mimic any company's artwork. Preserve true transparency.
